title: SWELL: a cheap automated expansion microscope (X-WOW invention #1), desk-stage design package
description:
SWELL is an open design for a cheap, automated expansion microscope that uses the sarcomeres of chicken muscle as a built-in ruler for local expansion. It is X-WOW invention #1, given away free: whoever builds it is welcome to claim the success.

Simulation only. Never built. The project stopped at the desk stage, before its first gate (G0); no gate was passed. This package holds the original brief, an audit, every design decision, a bill of materials with mostly estimated prices, optics and photon budgets, and simulation code with synthetic data and tests. No SWELL has been built or tested, and every result in it comes from simulation. Not yet written: the wet-lab protocol, the safety pack, the mechanical and fluidic design files (no CAD exists) and the instrument software.

This archive is a snapshot of the x-wow.com site repository at the release tag. The SWELL package itself is src/downloads/swell-g0-2026-10-09.zip, SHA-256 6003edff0165b19fc3cba11b94afa50ba5c025a49f5443130b167d0c3936d2a6.

Licences: text, data and code CC0 1.0; hardware design files CERN-OHL-P v2; the vendored three.js (src/assets/vendor/three/) keeps its MIT licence. Excluded from every licence here, whatever the record's licence field says: the X-WOW name and logo, including the logo artwork in src/assets/img/brand/, src/favicon.ico, src/assets/img/og-xwow.png and their copies in docs/. X-WOW is a trade mark, and the X-WOW logo (which includes the name) is a registered UK trade mark, UK00003425680.

MIT holds US patents on expansion microscopy; read the legal notes at https://x-wow.com/swell/#legal before any commercial use. Made with AI assistance (Claude by Anthropic, used through Claude Code), directed by the X-WOW owner.
